tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// shākya rak+ṣi ta'i lugs kyi lha mo rnam rgyal ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ gang la 'chi med tshe sgrub cing*// sdig 'phrog rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'jug /nyi ma'i bu las rgyal ba'i thabs// mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya// byang chub tu sems bskyed/ rang gi mdun du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sa gnon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad cing seng ge la bzhugs pa/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ grags chen snyan grags chen po pa// thub chen dpa' bo chen po pa// srid pa'i mya ngan brgal ba po// nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor las sngags phreng dang bh+rūm̐ yig brgya rtsa brgyad byung ste/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma dkar mo g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad du bzhugs/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun spyi bo nas blugs par bsams la/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ bcom ldan 'das ma bh+rūm̐ yig tu gyur/ bh+rūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas rang nyid gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mar gyur/ rang gi snying gar rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐/ mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ te/ a mṛ to ta bha be/ a mi ta bi krān+te/ a mi ta ga te/ a mṛ ta ga mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yurda de/ ga ga na kīrti ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung de nyid ci nus su bzla'o// gzungs ring la mos na stong phrag brgyad/ gzungs thung la mos na 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pas bsnyen pa'o// thun gyi mthar/

mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das la mchod bstod gsol gdab gong bzhin byas nas rang gi snying gar thim/ mjug tu dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'di'i lung 'bogs pa la/ thub dbang gi bris sku'i drung du dpon slob gnyis kas phyag mchod rgyas par bya/ slob dpon gyis gong du bshad pa'i sgom bzlas de tshar gcig byas nas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs ltar gsol ba gdab/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi mngon rtogs sgom tshul tshar gcig bshad nas/ gzungs ring thung gnyis la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa nyid yin no// rnam rgyal sgrub thabs sngon byung ba// kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i// ngo mtshar dga' bskyed chos mang can// snying po 'di 'dra'ang bdag gis thob// paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag gtsug tor rnam rgyal phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u tshan no// ༈ /'di'i sgom lung 'bogs pa'i tshul ni/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la lung 'bogs pa don med pas rgyud sde bzhi gang rung gi dbang thob pa la sgom bzlas kyi lung sbyin par bya ste/ thub pa'i dbang po dang gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung zhig gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dang so so'i phyag rgya bya/ mthar rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas te byin dbab/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra marda nā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ kra ma ṇa/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzla/ de nas thog mar/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing*/ thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ de la oṃ ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da rnams kyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ grags chen snyan grags chen po pa// thub chen dpa' bo chen po pa// srid pa'i mya ngan brgal ba po// nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces bstod nas/

bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i gtsug tor nas gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba dang bh+rūm̐ yig brgya rtsa brgyad skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu byung ste/ de rnams gcig tu 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'od zer dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad du dges bzhin bzhugs par bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag gi lhung bzed nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun rang gi spyi bo nas blugs pas lus gang zhing dri ma dang bral bar bsams la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba trai lo kya pra ti bi shiṣ+ḍā ya bud dhā ya te na maḥ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa man+ta a ba bhā sa s+pha ra ṇa ga ti/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shud dhe/ a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta su ga ta ba ra bā tsa na/ a mṛ ta a bhi ṣe ke re/ ma hā mu dra/ man+t+ra pa daiḥ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yuḥsan dhā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shud dhe/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shud dhe/ sa ha sra rasmi sañtso di te/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ni/ ṣa ṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta mā te da sha bhā mi pra tiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre/ badz+ra kā ya saṃ ha ta na/

pa ri shud dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud dhe/ pra ti ni brta ya/ ma ma ā yur bi shud dhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ ma hā mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ ma hā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti/ ma hā ma ti/ ma ma ti/ su ma ti/ ta thā tā/ bhū ta ko ṭi/ pa ri shud dhe/ bi s+phu ṭa/ bud dhi shud dhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ s+pha ra s+pha ra/ s+pha ra ya s+pha ra ya/ sarba bud dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ shud dhe shud dhe/ bud dhe bud dhe/ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ su badz+re/ badz+re gar+bhe/ dza ya gar+bhe/ bi dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wā la gar+bhe/ badz+ra ud bha be/ badz+ra saṃ bha be/ badz+re badz+re ṇi/ badz+ra m+bha ba tu/ ma ma sha rī raṃ sarba satwā nāñtsa kā ya pa ri shud dhi ra bha ba tu/ sa dā me sarba ga ti pa ri shud dhish+tsa/ sa man+t+wa na mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na/ sarba tha thā ga tāsh+tsa māṃ sa mā shwā sa yan+tu/ bud dh+ya bud dh+ya/ sid dh+ya sid dh+ya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sa man+tā rasmi pa ri shud dhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre ma hā mu drā man+t+ra pa daiḥswā hā/ zhes rnam rgyal gzungs ring nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma de nyid bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po 'od gsal ba zhig tu gyur/ de la dmigs te bh+rūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de ltar bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis bh+rūm̐ yig rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i skur lam gyis gyur par bsams la/ rang gi snying gar rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po zla ba chu shel gyi 'od 'tsher ba/ de'i mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dkar pos g.yas skor du bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ te/ a mṛ tod bha be/ a mi ta bikrān+te/ a mi ta ga te/ a mṛ ta ga mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yurda de/ ga ga na kīr+t+ti ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung 'di nyid ci nus su bzla'o// thun gyi mthar/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la gong ltar mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das rang gi snying gar thim par bsam mo// sgom lung bsdus pa la mdun bskyed ma byas kyang chog cing*/ rgyas pa ltar na/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus bh+rūm̐ la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza yā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil sogs la tshigs bcad dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur te/ shab+da'i tshe rol chen bya/ gdugs mchog ji snyed/ ts+tsha traṃ ka ba dan ji snyed/ pa taṃ ka spro na lda ldi ji snyed/ pa ḍa da ma pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa rgyas pa gang shes kyis bstod/ mdun gyi lha mo'i thugs kar 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po zla ba chu shel gyi 'od 'tsher ba/ de'i mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dkar pos g.yas skor du bskor bar bsams la/ gzungs ring gzungs thung ci nus su bzlas nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ slob ma la chab btang*/ mchod pa kha gsos la thub pa'i dbang po sras dang slob mar bcas pa sogs tshogs zhing rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bsang sbyang bya ba 'di dag lhan cig tu gsung bar zhu/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngon du 'gro bas ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa dpon slob lhan cig tu brjod/

de nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du sgom bzlas kyi lung zab mo gsan la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed cing*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas gsan par zhu/ de yang lus can rnams kyis don du gnyer bya mthar thug pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kho na yin la/ de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs 'chad pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang*/ de las kyang theg pa chen po pa kho na'i khyad chos yin cing*/ de la'ang don spyi ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid la brten nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' dag mi gnas pa'i myang 'das chen por gshegs shing gshegs par gyur ba ste/ de la'ang 'bras dus kyi sku dang ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs rim pa gnyis ni lam 'di'i nyams su blang bya'i rtsa ba yin cing de'i gzhi'am rtsa brgyud smin par byed pa la thug pas de nyid sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la'ang dbang*/ byin rlabs/ rig gtad/ bzlas lung ste rnam pa bzhi'i bye brag can du bzhugs pa las 'dir bya sla zhing bskyed bzlas la dbang bar byed pa bzlas lung 'bogs par byed pa yin/ de'ang lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams dang 'brel ba'i bka' srol mtha' yas pa las/ 'dir 'phags yul lho phyogs ra khang tsag+mar sku 'khrungs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon shākya rak+ṣi ta la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang ba'i sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad yod pa las/ slob dpon pūr+ṇa badz+ra las rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos sgrub thabs nyer bzhi gsan pa'i nang tshan las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bzlas lung sgrub pas chos 'di gang las brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/

grub chen shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bud+dha swā mī/ su dza ta/ sā dhu dz+nyā na/ saṃ pra kīrti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be dā ban+dhu/ bī ra mi tra/ pūr+ṇa badz+ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha nas rim par rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i bar du brgyud pa'i zam ma chad par byon pa de nyid kyi sgom bzlas kyi lung legs par bsgrub par bgyi ba la thog mar zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ ces mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas theg pa che chung gi lam gyi sgrub thabs thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum/ khyad par du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams gzhan du ma yengs par lha'i rnal 'byor 'di bzhin du bsgom 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar la/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sa de nyid du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus bh+rūm̐ la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i skur lam gyis gyur par mos nas/ slob dpon gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mar gsal gdab/

khyed rang rnams kyang gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mar gsal ba'i thugs kar 'od dpag med pa sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po zla ba chu shel gyi 'od 'tsher ba/ de'i mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dkar pos g.yas skor du bskor bar gsal btab pa/ slob dpon la mos gus drag po dung pa re mdzad pa la brten nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ yig gi mtha' skor du 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gzungs ring thung lan gsum re bzlar gzhug de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi ngag la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ des gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgom bzlas kyi lung legs par thob pa yin pas gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul/ dge bsngo bya/ rjes bdag mdun la mchod/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis bsngo smon dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa'ang sgrub thabs rin po che kun las btus pa'i zhal skong du blo gter dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
